existing_owner: Existing ARI/OCS/PCA; GATE/MCB for entitlement and commercial decisions
deliverable: Per-asset creator/source/license evidence and separate private use, session delivery, flattened-map output, raw redistribution, modification and attribution capabilities.

existing_owner: Existing ARI and native document extensibility
deliverable: Stable logical asset IDs, immutable rendition digests, pack/version dependencies, recipe version, scale, anchor, orientation, alpha, tags and source license refs.
acceptance: Two logical records can share bytes without merging rights; one version update cannot silently alter existing placement; unknown mandatory features reject clearly.

deliverable: Content validation, byte/dimension/frame/decoded-pixel limits, archive path/expansion limits, safe vector subset, staging, cancel and atomic registration.
acceptance: Reject traversal, duplicate-path, oversized-decode, malformed media and unsupported active content; interrupted import exposes no half-ready pack; originals preserved.

title: Prepare one coherent illustrated asset family
deliverable: Small settlement/interior/vegetation sample with reviewed crop/alpha, scale/anchor, pivot, palette, shadow policy, tile edges and source lineage.
acceptance: Before/after same-geometry scenes at multiple zooms; no white-box JPEG placement; edge halos and door/roof orientation checked; creator review distinct from automated metrics.

title: Build measured renditions and color/alpha pipeline
deliverable: Preserved source plus browser/play/thumbnail/print variants with explicit color, alpha, recipe and target profile; JPEG/WebP/PNG trials before AVIF/KTX2 adoption.
acceptance: Actual sample quality and target decode tested; no upsizing by default; opaque and translucent cases; black/white backgrounds, seam and repeated-edit checks; larger conversions retain source fallback.

title: Build usable asset discovery and editable placements
existing_owner: MME-03; ARI query/pagination and native placed-object owner
deliverable: Virtualized search/tag/style/scale library with cheap previews, recent/favorite sets, multi-placement and per-instance overrides/assemblies.
acceptance: Find and place within dense sample library without decoding all originals; edit one instance without changing others; missing pack and provenance visible.

title: Implement optional packs and crash-safe activation
deliverable: Small built-in set, local optional packs, dependency resolver, verified staging, atomic activation, rollback, pin/uninstall and last-good manifest.
acceptance: Interrupt download/write/verification/activation; every restart gives prior or new complete pack; required pinned content survives cache trim; offline availability is explicit.

title: Separate durable storage, caches and garbage collection
deliverable: Original/derivative storage and indexes; measured quotas; decoded/GPU lifetimes; safe eviction; retained references/checkpoints/offline pins; tombstones and repair.
acceptance: Low disk/quota denial leaves last valid document; eviction can rebuild disposable data; no deletion of referenced originals; clear-cache differs from delete-project; cross-tenant logical rights preserved.

title: Prove portable save, backup, restore and legacy migration
deliverable: Linked-save versus portable-bundle choices, dependency-closure report, license-aware inclusion, safe restore and copy-based reviewed legacy import.
acceptance: Restore on an empty profile without source folders; missing/nonredistributable dependencies explicit; repeated restore safe; legacy file unchanged and native IDs preserved where appropriate.

deliverable: Relationship-aware joins and architectural assemblies, linked door openings, roof/wall art and boundary editing; general road joins beyond consecutive rendering runs.
acceptance: Crossing/branching/nonconsecutive roads merge visually without closing bridges; room edits preserve or explicitly invalidate attached doors/blockers; geometry and gameplay remain distinct.

existing_owner: MME-02E0/E3; procedural and specialty spatial owners
deliverable: Seeded biome/district-aware placement, exclusions, assemblies and regenerate-selected controls for regional, city, cave, interior and specialty fixtures.
acceptance: Pinned edits survive regeneration; same seed+recipe deterministic; all placed results editable; clearance and district composition improve without adding gameplay simulation.

title: Unify materials, depth, shadows, labels and style packs
deliverable: Coherent natural/manufactured materials, zoom-stable details, shared art direction, structural shadows/atmosphere and readable genre labels.
acceptance: Same regional/settlement/interior/tactical geometry compared before/after at fixed zooms; removable grid and source geometry preserved; decorative lighting changes no sight authority.
